title: Application Lifecycle Management
summary: This module manages the application's startup and shutdown processes, including loading the core text generation model and its dependencies. It also provides an endpoint to report the current health status of various application components.

nodes.label: Initialize Application
nodes.title: Application Initialization
nodes.description: Handles application startup and shutdown, including loading the text generation model (Hugging Face pipeline) based on environment variables and GPU availability. Manages the global model pipeline and triggers SAE loading.

nodes.label: Provide Health Status
nodes.title: Application Health Endpoint
nodes.description: Exposes an API endpoint to report the current health status of the application, including model loading, SAE status, persona steering configurations, and DND playground bundles.

nodes.label: Hugging Face Token
nodes.title: HF_TOKEN Environment Variable
nodes.description: An environment variable crucial for authenticating with Hugging Face to download and load the text generation model. If not set, the model loading is skipped.

nodes.label: Text Generation Pipeline
nodes.title: Hugging Face Model Pipeline
nodes.description: The core text generation pipeline, loaded using the Hugging Face transformers library. Its availability is critical for chat functionalities.

nodes.label: SAE Analysis Module
nodes.title: Sparse Autoencoder Module
nodes.description: A module responsible for loading and managing Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) for advanced model analysis, integrated during application startup.

nodes.label: Persona Steering State
nodes.title: Persona Steering Configuration
nodes.description: In-memory state and environment variables related to persona steering vectors and bundles, influencing how personas are applied.

nodes.label: DND Playground State
nodes.title: DND Playground Configuration
nodes.description: In-memory state related to DND playground bundles, used for interactive persona exploration.

groups.label: Surface API
groups.title: User-Facing API
groups.description: Components that expose functionality directly to users or other services.

groups.label: Generative Core
groups.title: Core Generation Setup
groups.description: Components responsible for setting up and managing the generative AI model.

groups.label: Data & Configuration
groups.title: Data Sources and Configuration
groups.description: External data sources or configuration states that influence application behavior.

groups.label: Analytical Components
groups.title: Analytical Modules
groups.description: Modules primarily involved in analysis or introspection of the model.
